limits: Local execution costs; no matched hosted discovery cost comparison.
Bounded values and configurations; not complete API or backend coverage.

Rust and C++ matrix callees are generic stubs with native declaration assertions; Python and Go consumers compare the passed values. The permanent C++ runner additionally checks a real consumer in all three dialects.
Broad controllers are archived research, not production tools or normal CI.
Raw generated programs and logs remain in the local report directory, not this archive.
excluded_exploration: Initial Ruby keyword-call and JavaScript object-call adapters wrapped arguments incorrectly.
JavaScript dates and naive datetimes require local-calendar reconstruction rather than a UTC oracle.
The first Go composition adapter placed oracle imports after type declarations.
The first C++ adapter omitted file-scope stubs, used the wrong C++ dialect, or omitted the main entry point.
Rust equality against vec![] added an ambiguous oracle type; is_empty() is the correct native empty-sequence check.
Original mutations could create invalid encoded values; the final value-mutation audit retains valid tagged payloads and unchanged mapping keys.
One combined source snapshot was captured during a temporary baseline proof; it is excluded. Final source hashes and heads are recorded separately.
